name: android
blurb: Android phone mockup SVG frame for displaying images or videos.
description: Renders a realistic Android device bezel and screen in SVG. Accepts an image URL or video element as content to fill the display. Supports dark mode.
use_when: Presenting app screenshots or videos in a phone mockup frame.
avoid_when: When the content needs interactive controls or must respond to device viewport changes.
a11y: Image has no alt text. Video is muted and plays automatically. No keyboard interactions.
